cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Approve the Harmless Version
cards.instruction: Get approval for a harmless version of your plan, then gradually reveal what that approval now commits them to.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Can two relatives come for tea? You learnt to lay out the cups from me; this will be an easy table.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Confident at last. They're bringing four cousins, so put out the big pot I taught you to warm first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How many people have I agreed to feed?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The original two, with four guests between them. Six cups, and cut each sandwich in half like we practised. You said we could host them; help me make everyone fit.

reason: Use specific shared tuition to change how A pursues the exact Drive. Preserve practical offers and concerns from B, and make A5 a playable response rather than a summary of the relationship mechanism.
